acceptance_checks.evidence: I070 receipt and review are pass and are hash-bound inputs of the accepted I080 receipt.
The run constructs only in-memory synthetic records and retains exactly two raw groups in each of D_b_tr, D_b_prob, D_e_tr, and D_e_te; no archive is opened or extracted.
Raw groups are assigned before deterministic group split; duplicate, file, split, and three-seed 10 percent few-shot manifests are written as structured Parquet and revalidated on every read.

Independent visible and thermal YOLOv8n adapters with synthetic backends, post-NMS concept max aggregation, explicit concept rows, and D_b_prob-only Platt calibration complete with finite [0,1] outputs.

Causal statistics, D_b_tr standardization, persistence rule, one HGB fit, one-step GRU training, independent inference, and one-to-one event evaluation complete; 20 fit rows and 4 inference rows have distinct input hashes.
Mean, one-step calibrated-logit, one-step reliability graph with observed-pair edges, memory state transitions, and episode event evaluation complete; 8 fit and 8 inference rows have distinct hashes.
Branch and episode prediction artifacts reject truth, label, target, and test-metric columns; episode outputs use unique 64-hex HMAC skeleton join keys.
Validation loads every Parquet/JSON/log artifact and checks schemas, primary keys, probability ranges, seeds, diagnostic counts, timestamps, fit/inference hashes, and zero remote side effects.
Parquet publication uses stage-then-hard-link write-once semantics; JSON/text use write-once helpers; a second CLI invocation validates the existing bundle with all 11 file hashes unchanged.
Tests reject dirty roots, hash drift, untracked directories, rehashed semantic remote-side-effect claims, Parquet overwrite attempts, and unsupported CLI step dispatch.

The integration source has zero references to dataset roots, archive extraction, network clients, either remote host, SSH, or sbatch; runtime receipts record zero extraction, remote connections, and Slurm jobs.
The frozen I080 command passed 5/5 in 90.58s; compileall passed; the full project suite passed 58/58 in 140.02s.
The persistent local integration bundle contains 10 hash-managed artifacts plus its receipt, 41259 bytes total, and receipt SHA-256 c2b6dcee33ea79723213ad54666d043f74a737e04f2eaf827de0968830b7d124.
The accepted test receipt contains 36 independently rechecked input hashes with zero mismatch and SHA-256 1ab9ad7855de5269b41704a74e946906bce4e2ec41d956950025656620fb2048.

findings: Attempt 1 passed its then-current tests but was rejected for fit/inference reuse, transparent episode IDs, and incomplete output closure.
Attempt 2 passed after pool and ID repair but was rejected because hash checks alone did not prove artifact semantics.
Attempt 3 passed semantic tests but was rejected because atomic Parquet replacement was not strict write-once publication.
Attempt 4 closes the executable integration, semantic, no-overwrite, and idempotence boundaries.

I080 establishes only local synthetic integration readiness. It does not establish real dataset readiness, remote environment readiness, training completion, comparative performance, or manuscript result support.
